spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing three-quarter view standing on a plain light background with a soft shadow beneath it. It has a low, elongated quadrupedal body with a broad, flat-snouted pale pinkish-beige head at the front and a long, thick tapering tail extending to the left rear. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the base of the tail is domed and covered in dense, overlapping large brown scales, while the head, sides, belly, limbs and tail are covered in pale, glossy, wrinkled skin with transverse folds. Six dark reddish-brown feathery branching structures protrude from the sides of the neck just behind the head, three per side. It stands on four stout limbs with broad clawed feet, and has large round eyes with golden-brown irises on the sides of the head.
